content: Ɗaghantɗaag nǝ Yesu kǝ mbǝrzahaana
Kaa ɗahtǝrantɗahǝg nǝ Yesu kǝ mbǝrzahaan kǝlaawa tar buwa. Vǝlatǝrvǝlǝg kǝ ndzǝɗa lagwa shatanaha ar mbaha kuzah shahshaha ard lii yang biya.
Wan nǝ ɗaagaha mbǝrzah kǝlaawa tar buna. Dǝga zǝnngwa iin nǝ Siman kwa ɗahav dǝ Bitrus ard dǝ zǝra babbaan Andrawus ard Yakubu zǝra Zabadi ard zǝra babbaan Yuhwana,
ard Filigus ard Batalomi ard Tuma ard Matiyu dadda cauwa hadama ard Yakubu zǝra Halfa ard Taddiyus,
Siman kwa naagaan kǝ za vukwa kǝsaana, ard Yahuda Iskariyoti kwa zuu langiya Yesu.
Ɓǝlatǝrǝtɓǝlǝg nǝ Yesu kǝ kǝlaawa tar buwa
Ɓǝlatǝrǝtɓǝlǝg nǝ Yesu kǝ mbǝrzahaan kǝlaawa tar buna, amaa taa kǝ iitǝra, “Dam bi davak lii ar Yahudah biya, ɗlaɓa dam bi damma kǝssa Samariyah biya.
Dlakulva kwaha damdǝg da vak tughaha uudaha Izraila kwa zaharazahǝga.
Damdǝg tagamtǝrtag kǝ ǝlbǝg marawa taakiya, ‘Tlǝksǝra ghǝrazhigǝla hǝrzǝthǝrzǝga.’
Mbahamtǝrmbahǝg kǝ lii yang biya, ciyamtǝrciig kǝ lii ǝmtsaharaǝmtsahǝga, mbahamtǝrmbahǝg kǝ magyagulfaha, lagwamlagw kǝ Shatanaha. Tlamkǝna ba gyaagyaana vǝlamtǝrvǝlǝg ba gyaagyaana.
Kǝsam bi kǝ adawana, aanji agwalɛl, aanji vǝrzhagan ma ambǝlaru biya.
Kǝsam bi kǝ ambǝl mam dagal biya, aanji sǝɗav buwa, aanji kimbak aanji zad biya, aɗaba dadda ɓa tlǝra dlaikǝndlaig nǝ dǝgshigaana.
“Baɗǝm nǝ kǝsa ard gǝdzǝr kǝssahi am dǝgaa nǝ uurama, gatamgatǝg kǝ uuda jiirjiir am ndzan ma vǝgyaana tangw damma sarti am da ciig nǝ uurama.
Akwama damaghan da hǝnyahiina, tagamtǝrtag taakiya, ‘Gabǝrǝr tǝghǝr kǝskurama.’
Akwama uudaha jiirjiir wa ma hǝnyahiina, gabǝraruwa aa ndzandzǝg tǝghǝr kǝ iitǝra, akwama uudaha jiirjiir biya, gabǝraruwa gwiya saa kǝskurama.
Baɗǝm daddakwa lawalǝg kǝ dlǝgha kurama, ard cinnga ǝlbǝgaruwa, pangamdapang kǝ alagwat tǝ shigaharuwu akwamam da ɗuwa kǝsaatǝra.
Bak jiir wan tagkur naiya, da zhuvtǝrdaala kǝ uudaha Sadum ard Gumara tǝghǝr kǝ uudaha kǝssiin daghuvala ta shariya.
Dlaɗ kwada sagauwa
“Wan ɓǝlkurɓǝlǝg band tuughwah ma taataka ghǝgyaha tǝghala, mbakyarvad kwaha ndzamandzǝg ba ɗyamɗyam band ghavala, dlaɓa am nal kalaliyah band kakuura.
Famfǝg kǝ hyǝmmi dǝ uudah aɗaba ar da langkurlang damma guda ta shariya, ar da ɓalkura kiiɓ ma guda dzǝgwazhigǝlaatǝra.
Ar da langkurlang da tǝvuukwa maamaalah ard tlǝkǝssah mbakyarvad kaiya, kiyava taa ǝlbǝg maraw kǝskuram tǝvuukwatǝra ard tǝvuukwa lii ar yahudah biya.
Akwama langarkurdalanga, ndavam bi kǝ dǝgiti am da tag nǝ uuram biya, ard ɗuuli am da tag nǝ uuram biya, aɗaba da vǝlkurvǝlǝg nǝ uud kǝ dǝga tagga.
Aɗaba kuram bi wada taaghai biya, shǝɗkwa Daadaru wa da taaghai mbakyarvad kurama.
“Zǝraaba da za lanngiya zǝraabaan da tsǝvana, daada da za lanngiya zǝraana, zarha ar da ciitǝrant kǝ yaatǝra da ciɓǝvtǝrana.
Uudah baɗǝm ar da naakur bi mbakyarvad ɗaagara, dlaɓa baɗǝm daddakwa ghacaghacig dat ghalaana, da tlǝkǝnatlǝg kǝ katǝga.
Akwamar vǝlkur dlaɗ ma kwatlǝrǝn kǝssa, ǝmndǝraǝmdǝrga damma kǝssi tǝvuukwa, jiira wan takur naiya lakuti am tsǝgarvaratsǝg kǝ kǝsaha Izraila baɗǝmma, da saaya nǝ Zǝra Uuda.
“Daddakwa tsaga dǝgit vak kǝ uuda jiguubi kǝ dadda tsagar dǝgit biya, jiguubi dlaba nǝ kwatnah kǝ dadda hǝnyahaan biya.

Tlǝgaltlǝg nǝ dadda tsaga dǝgit vak kǝ uuda, nal band dadda tsagar dǝgita, dlaɓa kwatnah band dadda hǝnnyahaana. Akwamar ɗaag dǝ Baˈalzabul kǝ dadda hǝnnyaha, ar da ɗaatǝr dǝ kwa juujig kǝ Baˈalzabul kǝ uudahi ma hǝnnyahiina.
Daddakwa da Gǝdzava
“Mbakyarvad kwaha, gǝdzamtǝr biya, aɗaba maay nǝ dǝgiti hǝɗahǝdan kwa da maay wurav biya, dlaɓa maay nǝ dǝgiti shiɓashiɓan kwa da sǝrvaaka biya.
Dǝgiti taagankur nai magurtla, tagamtag bat ɓalaɓala, dǝgiti cinngama nǝ uram da gǝlagǝla, tlǝhamtlǝhǝg tǝ ghǝra guda.
Gǝdzam bi kǝ lii tsǝgatsǝg kǝ vǝgha biya aɗaba ar maay dǝ ndzǝɗa tsa shifǝg biya, gǝdzamgǝdzǝg kǝ dadda kwa tsǝgatsǝg kǝ vǝgh ard shifǝg ma kaarafaiya.
Maay kwan vǝlav nǝ caakwah bu tǝ kwaɓ pal biya? Bakǝvakwaha maay aanji pallǝratǝr ɓǝladagal da tǝ haay kwal sǝrga bi kǝ daadaru biya.
Baz guujaha ghǝraharu ndakwani kǝdlakǝdlana.
Mbakyarvad kwaha, ndavam biya, jamujig nǝ uuram kǝ caakwah baɗyak dǝ ndanngǝra.
Mara haiganthaig dǝ Kǝristi tǝvuukwa uudaha
“Baɗǝm daddakwa haiyakuthaig kǝskai tǝvuukwa uudaha, kai ndakwi ǝn da haiganthaiga dǝ iin tǝvuukwa Daadar kwa ma ghǝrazhigǝla.
Aiciya, badǝm daddakwa haiyakut bi tǝvuukwa uudah biya, kai ndakwani ǝn da haigant bi dǝ iin tǝvuukwa Daadar kwa ma ghǝrazhigǝl biya.
Sandi gabbǝrǝr bi nai biya ba tagwazhatagwazha
“Tlatlam bi taakiya sanhi kwakyarvad ǝn vǝlkur kǝ gabǝrǝr nai damma duni biya, maaya, sanhi kwakyarvad ǝn vǝlkur kǝ gabǝrǝr biya, ba tagwazhatagwazha.
Sandi tagwazhatagwazha, adaba

content.text: dughwa da ɓa dau dǝ babbaana,
ghuul dlaɓa dǝ ɓa dau dǝ jikkan uusa.
war da ɓa dau dǝ iina.’

content: “Badǝm nǝ daddakwa waiya daddaan bi babbaana tǝghǝr kǝskaiya, tlǝgal bi kǝ nǝg kǝ dǝgar biya. Dlaɓa baɗǝm nǝ daddakwa waiya zǝraan bi dǝghwaana tǝghǝr kǝskaiya tlǝgal bi kǝ nǝg kǝ dǝgar biya.
Badǝm nǝ daddakwa kǝsǝghanti kǝ tlaɓahǝrtǝgaan ngal gata kai biya, tlǝgal bi kǝ nǝg kǝ dǝgar biya.
Baɗǝm nǝ daddakwa naa kata shifǝgaana, ɓǝlgaan dagala. Baɗǝm nǝ daddakwa ɓǝlda shifǝgaan kwakyarvad kaiya aa fǝgabadfǝga.
Tlǝraha dǝgshiga
“Baɗǝm nǝ daddakwa dlǝghakuradlǝghǝga, dlǝghakwidlǝghǝg kǝskaiya, baɗǝm nǝ daddakwa dlǝghakwidlǝghǝga, dlaghaadlǝghǝg kǝ daddakwa ɓǝlkwadi kaiya.

Baɗǝm nǝ daddakwa dlaghaadlǝghǝg kǝ tlayanga kwakyarvad tlayang nǝ iina, da tlǝkǝnatlǝg kǝ dǝgshiga tlayanga. Dlaɓa badǝm nǝ daddakwa dlaghaadlǝghǝg kǝ uuda jirjira kwakyarvad uuda jirjira nǝ iina, da tlǝkǝnatlǝga kǝ dǝgshiga uuda jirjiira.
Baɗǝm nǝ daddakwa vǝlgar kuwa yu lǝmcikcik kǝ pall ma lii hǝɗiikǝn kwakyarvad mbǝrzar nǝ iina, ǝn takurtaga da pilwai nǝ dǝgshigaan biya.”
